(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem)=
# Module: misc.symbolicSystem

The equations of motion of a system as symbolic programs (#3110, #3113, design:
docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md): SymbolicSystemBase is the interface of the ODE2 equations
M(q, t) q_tt = f(q, q_t, t) on which the solvers work. SymbolicSystem(mbs) extracts them, after
mbs.Assemble(), from the objects with symbolic user functions, collected in kinds - the objects whose user
functions are the same recordings -, each with the table of its objects, their parameters and the global
indices of their ODE2 coordinates (the local-to-global maps of systemData). It evaluates the residual
r = M q_tt - f, the sparse mass matrix, the forces and the Jacobian of r by exudyn.symbolic, and writes a
computed state back into mbs, where the renderer, the sensors and the output functions read it.
NumpySystem takes equations written by hand. SolveExplicit integrates any of them by explicit Euler, RK44
or velocity Verlet, as Exudyn's explicit solver does (#3112), SolveGeneralizedAlpha by the generalized-alpha
method, as Exudyn's implicit solver does (#3126).
Equations() gives the equations of the system as expressions in the system variables q, q_t, q_tt and t -
exudyn.symbolic, whose flat program GetFlatProgram() writes, or sympy - composed of the recordings (#3130);
the forces and the mass matrix of these expressions, recorded once, are what Forces, MassMatrix and Residual
evaluate: one call each for the whole system (#3131).
Special: not for the broad use, a basis for the export of the equations of motion and their evaluation
outside Exudyn. The items it takes: ObjectUserBody with symbolic massMatrixUserFunction and
forceUserFunction, ObjectGenericODE2 with constant matrices and symbolic user functions,
ObjectConnectorUser with a symbolic forceUserFunction on position markers of point nodes, on position and
rigid markers of the ground and of user bodies, with the rotations if it requests them (#3121, #3129), items
without coordinates (ground), and the loads LoadForceVector, LoadTorqueVector,
LoadMassProportional and LoadCoordinate, constant or with a symbolic user function of the time, on markers
of point nodes, node coordinates and user bodies (#3118); every other object and load, constraints and
recordings that read mbs are refused.

- **Author**: Johannes Gerstmayr
- **Date**: 2026-10-26 (created)

(sec-symbolicsystem-solveexplicit)=
## Function: SolveExplicit

[`SolveExplicit(system, simulationSettings = None, solverType = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L1202)

- **function description**: the explicit time integration of a SymbolicSystemBase with constant step size, by explicit Euler, RK44 or velocity Verlet, as Exudyn's explicit solver computes them (#3112, design docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md §10): the steps from timeIntegration.startTime, endTime and numberOfSteps; the accelerations by the inverse per body with timeIntegration.explicit.computeMassMatrixInversePerBody, else by the sparse LU decomposition of the mass matrix, both once for a constant mass matrix (timeIntegration.reuseConstantMassMatrix); for a SymbolicSystem the solution file, the sensors and the renderer of its mbs by simulationSettings.solution, as after SolveDynamic
- **input**:
  - `system`: the system, a SymbolicSystemBase
  - `simulationSettings`: exudyn.SimulationSettings; None: the defaults
  - `solverType`: an exudyn.DynamicSolverType of explicitSolverTypes; None: timeIntegration.solverType
- **output**: dict with 'time' (n_out), 'q', 'q_t', 'q_tt' (n_out x nODE2) at the steps of solution.file.writePeriod and the last step, and the statistics 'steps', 'forceEvaluations', 'massMatrixEvaluations'


Relevant Examples (Ex) and TestModels (TM) with weblink to github: [`symbolicSystemSpringDamper.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/Examples/symbolicSystemSpringDamper.py) (Ex), [`symbolicExplicitSolverTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicExplicitSolverTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicSystemLoadsTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSystemLoadsTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicUserItemsTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserItemsTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py) (TM)


(sec-symbolicsystem-solvegeneralizedalpha)=
## Function: SolveGeneralizedAlpha

[`SolveGeneralizedAlpha(system, simulationSettings = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L1276)

- **function description**: the implicit time integration of a SymbolicSystemBase with constant step size by the generalized-alpha method in the form of Arnold and Bruls, as Exudyn's MainSolverImplicitSecondOrder computes it (#3126, design docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md §6): per step the predictor of the displacements, velocities and algorithmic accelerations, then Newton's method for the accelerations with the residual r = M q_tt - f and the Jacobian beta' M + gamma' dr/dq_t + dr/dq of ResidualJacobian; by timeIntegration: numberOfSteps, startTime, endTime, generalizedAlpha.spectralRadius, useNewmark with newmarkBeta and newmarkGamma, computeInitialAccelerations, and newton.relativeTolerance, absoluteTolerance, maxIterations, useModifiedNewton (the Jacobian once per step) and weightTolerancePerCoordinate; for a SymbolicSystem the solution file, the sensors and the renderer of its mbs, as SolveExplicit. A step whose Newton iteration does not converge raises: the step size is constant
- **input**:
  - `system`: the system, a SymbolicSystemBase
  - `simulationSettings`: exudyn.SimulationSettings; None: the defaults
- **output**: dict with 'time' (n_out), 'q', 'q_t', 'q_tt' (n_out x nODE2) at the steps of solution.file.writePeriod and the last step, and the statistics 'steps', 'newtonIterations', 'jacobianEvaluations'


Relevant Examples (Ex) and TestModels (TM) with weblink to github: [`symbolicSystemRigidBodyPendulum.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/Examples/symbolicSystemRigidBodyPendulum.py) (Ex), [`symbolicGeneralizedAlphaTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicGeneralizedAlphaTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py) (TM)


(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem-class-symbolicsystembase)=
## CLASS SymbolicSystemBase (in module misc.symbolicSystem)

**class description**: the ODE2 equations of motion M(q, t) q_tt = f(q, q_t, t) of nODE2 coordinates, the interface on which the solvers work (#3113): a derived class sets nODE2 and computes Forces and MassMatrixTriplets (or MassMatrix); the residual and its Jacobian follow from them, unless the derived class computes them itself

- **notes**: Its member: nODE2, the number of ODE2 coordinates

The base class gives one block of all coordinates


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystembase-residual)=
### Class function: Residual

[`Residual(self, q = None, q_t = None, q_tt = None, t = 0.)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L105)

- **class function description**: the residual r = M(q, t) q_tt - f(q, q_t, t), of size nODE2


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystembase-residualjacobian)=
### Class function: ResidualJacobian

[`ResidualJacobian(self, q = None, q_t = None, q_tt = None, t = 0., factor_q = 1., factor_q_t = 0., factor_q_tt = 0., sparse = False, epsilon = 1e-6)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L110)

- **class function description**: the Jacobian of the residual, factor_q dr/dq + factor_q_t dr/dq_t + factor_q_tt dr/dq_tt, by central differences of Residual - for a system without derivatives of its own; factor_q_tt=1 alone gives the mass matrix, a Newton step of an implicit integrator combines the three
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates, of size nODE2; None: zero
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: zero
  - `q_tt`: the ODE2 accelerations; None: zero
  - `t`: the time
  - `factor_q`: the factor of dr/dq
  - `factor_q_t`: the factor of dr/dq_t
  - `factor_q_tt`: the factor of dr/dq_tt
  - `sparse`: True: a scipy.sparse.csr_matrix, else a dense array
  - `epsilon`: the step of the differences
- **output**: the matrix (nODE2 x nODE2)

(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem-class-numpysystem(symbolicsystembase))=
## CLASS NumpySystem(SymbolicSystemBase) (in module misc.symbolicSystem)

**class description**: ODE2 equations M q_tt = f(q, q_t, t) written by hand, e.g. with numpy: the simplest system for a solver of this module, and a check of it independent of Exudyn (#3112)

- **input**:
  - `massMatrix`: the mass matrix, constant (numpy array or scipy sparse matrix) or a function (q, q_t, t) -> matrix
  - `forces`: the function (q, q_t, t) -> f, of size nODE2
  - `initialState`: (q0, q_t0); None: zero
  - `massMatrixBlocks`: the blocks of bodies as SymbolicSystemBase.MassMatrixBlocks returns them, for a constant mass matrix; None: one block of all coordinates

(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem-class-symbolickind)=
## CLASS SymbolicKind (in module misc.symbolicSystem)

**class description**: the objects of one object type whose user functions are the same recordings: one recording per user function, the table of the objects, their parameters and the global indices of their ODE2 coordinates

- **notes**: Its members: objectType, the type name 'UserBody', 'GenericODE2' or 'ConnectorUser'; recordings, the dict of the recorded user functions by name (a name without recording is missing); objects, the list of the object numbers; ltg, the array (number of objects x local coordinates) of the global ODE2 indices; parameters, the list of the parameter vectors of the objects (UserBody), of the dicts of the constant matrices and the force vector (GenericODE2), or of the dicts of the parameter vector, 'orientation' (the connector gets the rotations and returns the torques) and the markers (ConnectorUser: per marker a dict of its 'type' - 'fixed', 'point' or 'body' -, its local coordinate indices 'indices', its reference 'position' and 'rotation' - for a marker on a user body its local position and rotation, 'objectNumber', 'qRef', 'parameters' and the 'recordings' of the body that give its kinematics)

(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem-class-symbolicload)=
## CLASS SymbolicLoad (in module misc.symbolicSystem)

**class description**: a load of the system (#3118): its value, constant or by the recording of its user function of the time, and how it acts on the coordinates - directly on the coordinates of a point node or on one node coordinate, or through a user function of the user body of its marker

- **notes**: Its members: loadNumber; loadType, 'ForceVector', 'TorqueVector', 'MassProportional' or 'Coordinate'; ltg, the global ODE2 indices it acts on; value, the loadVector or load; recording, the recorded loadVectorUserFunction or loadUserFunction, None if constant; body, None for a node marker, else the dict of the user body: 'objectNumber', 'localPosition', 'qRef', 'parameters', 'projection' (the recording of the function whose transposed maps the load into the coordinates) with its 'projectionName', and 'rotation' (the recorded rotationMatrixUserFunction for bodyFixed, else None)

(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem-class-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase))=
## CLASS SymbolicSystem(SymbolicSystemBase) (in module misc.symbolicSystem)

**class description**: the ODE2 equations of motion of mbs, by kinds of objects with symbolic user functions, evaluated by exudyn.symbolic (#3110, #3113); mbs must be assembled; see the Details of this module for the items it takes

- **input**:
  - `mbs`: the assembled MainSystem
  - `composeSystem`: True: Forces, MassMatrix and Residual evaluate two recordings of the composed system - the forces and the nonzero entries of the mass matrix of Equations(), each one flat program (#3131) -; False: each object and load by its own recordings, one call each
- **notes**: Its members: mbs; kinds, the list of SymbolicKind; loads, the list of SymbolicLoad; nODE2, the number of ODE2 coordinates of the system; qRef, the reference values of the ODE2 coordinates; composed, None or the dict of the recordings 'forces' and 'massMatrix' and the 'rows' and 'columns' of the entries of the mass matrix

### Class function: _LoadJacobian

[`_LoadJacobian(self, load, q, q_t, t, factor_q, factor_q_t)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L613)

- **class function description**: the local Jacobian of the residual -f of a load on a user body, by Diff of the recordings of the body; a load on a node or a coordinate depends on the time only


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)--localforces)=
### Class function: _LocalForces

[`_LocalForces(self, kind, i, q, q_t, t)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L647)

- **class function description**: the forces on the right-hand side; for ObjectGenericODE2 f + f_user - K q - D q_t


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-forces)=
### Class function: Forces

[`Forces(self, q = None, q_t = None, t = 0.)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L673)

- **class function description**: the global forces f(q, q_t, t) of the right-hand side, as the ODE2 part of the solver's right-hand side
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates (displacements), of size nODE2; None: zero
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: zero
  - `t`: the time
- **output**: the vector f of size nODE2


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-massmatrixtriplets)=
### Class function: MassMatrixTriplets

[`MassMatrixTriplets(self, q = None, q_t = None, t = 0.)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L695)

- **class function description**: the global mass matrix as triplets (rows, columns, values), a value per nonzero local entry; equal rows and columns are added when the matrix is formed


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-massmatrixblocks)=
### Class function: MassMatrixBlocks

[`MassMatrixBlocks(self, q = None, q_t = None, t = 0.)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L714)

- **class function description**: the local mass matrices of the objects, per kind: a list of (ltg, blocks), the LTG table of the kind and its mass matrices (objects x n x n)


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-residual)=
### Class function: Residual

[`Residual(self, q = None, q_t = None, q_tt = None, t = 0.)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L721)

- **class function description**: the residual r = M(q) q_tt - f(q, q_t, t) of the ODE2 equations without forming M: by the recordings of the composed system, else object by object


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-residualjacobian)=
### Class function: ResidualJacobian

[`ResidualJacobian(self, q = None, q_t = None, q_tt = None, t = 0., factor_q = 1., factor_q_t = 0., factor_q_tt = 0., sparse = False)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L738)

- **class function description**: the Jacobian of the residual, factor_q dr/dq + factor_q_t dr/dq_t + factor_q_tt dr/dq_tt, object by object by Diff of the recordings (UserFunction.EvaluateJacobian, #3115): exact, one derivative of the tree per column; factor_q_tt=1 alone gives the mass matrix, a Newton step of an implicit integrator combines the three
- **input**:
  - `q`: the ODE2 coordinates, of size nODE2; None: zero
  - `q_t`: the ODE2 velocities; None: zero
  - `q_tt`: the ODE2 accelerations; None: zero
  - `t`: the time
  - `factor_q`: the factor of dr/dq
  - `factor_q_t`: the factor of dr/dq_t
  - `factor_q_tt`: the factor of dr/dq_tt
  - `sparse`: True: a scipy.sparse.csr_matrix, else a dense array
- **output**: the matrix (nODE2 x nODE2)


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)--connectorjacobian)=
### Class function: _ConnectorJacobian

[`_ConnectorJacobian(self, kind, i, q, q_t, t, factor_q, factor_q_t)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L803)

- **class function description**: the local Jacobian of the residual -f of a connector, -d(sum_k J_pos,k^T f_k + J_rot,k^T m_k): the derivatives of its forces by the states of its markers (arguments 3 + 4k to 6 + 4k) composed with the derivatives of the states by the coordinates - J_pos, dJ_pos/dq q_t, dA/dq, J_rot, dJ_rot/dq q_t, by Diff of the recordings of the bodies -, and the derivatives of the Jacobians of the bodies times the forces (#3129)


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-equations)=
### Class function: Equations

[`Equations(self, format = 'symbolic', optimize = True, variables = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L860)

- **class function description**: the equations of motion of the system as expressions in its variables (#3130): the mass matrix M(q, t), the forces f(q, q_t, t) and the residual r = M q_tt - f, composed of the recordings of the kinds, the marker kinematics of the connectors and the loads; each recording is called with symbolic arguments through its code of exudyn.misc.symbolicExport, the parameters of the items and the reference coordinates are numbers
- **input**:
  - `format`: 'symbolic': exudyn.symbolic expressions, the variables named vectors q, q_t, q_tt (with the initial state as values) and the real t; 'sympy': sympy expressions of the symbols q0, q1, ..., q_t0, ..., q_tt0, ..., t (sympy must be installed)
  - `optimize`: for 'symbolic', simplify the expressions by exudyn.symbolic.Optimize, level 2 (1*x, x+0, 0*x, the combination of numbers, ...)
  - `variables`: None, or (q, q_t, q_tt, t) of the format given by the caller - e.g. the arguments of a function being recorded -, used instead of new variables
- **output**: dict with 'q', 'q_t', 'q_tt', 't' (the variables), 'massMatrix' (nODE2 x nODE2), 'forces' and 'residual' (nODE2), as exudyn.symbolic.Matrix and Vector or sympy.Matrix


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)--equationlists)=
### Class function: _EquationLists

[`_EquationLists(self, backend, q, q_t, t)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L901)

- **class function description**: the mass matrix as list of rows and the forces as list of the expressions of Equations, of the variables q, q_t and t of backend


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)--connectorequations)=
### Class function: _ConnectorEquations

[`_ConnectorEquations(self, kind, index, backend, Call, t, qs, q_ts, f)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L980)

- **class function description**: add the generalized forces of connector index of kind to the list f, as expressions: the marker states as in _ConnectorStates, the forces of the recording, J_pos^T f + J_rot^T m of each marker


(sec-symbolicsystem-symbolicsystem(symbolicsystembase)-getflatprogram)=
### Class function: GetFlatProgram

[`GetFlatProgram(self, format = 'Python', flatten = True)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L1027)

- **class function description**: the flat program of the residual r = M(q, t) q_tt - f(q, q_t, t) of Equations(), a function of q, q_t, q_tt and t (#3130)
- **input**:
  - `format`: 'Python' (the text), or the executable 'symbolic', 'numpy' or 'sympy' of exudyn.misc.symbolicExport
  - `flatten`: True: one line per operation; False: the result as one expression
- **output**: the program as str

(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem-class--backend)=
## CLASS _Backend (in module misc.symbolicSystem)

**class description**: the types of Equations: exudyn.symbolic or sympy


(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem-class--massmatrixsolver)=
## CLASS _MassMatrixSolver (in module misc.symbolicSystem)

**class description**: the accelerations a = M^-1 f of a system: by the inverse per body, or by the LU decomposition of M, dense up to _denseMassMatrixSize coordinates, else sparse; the inverse or the decomposition computed once for a constant mass matrix


(sec-module-misc.symbolicsystem-class--output)=
## CLASS _Output (in module misc.symbolicSystem)

**class description**: the output of a solver of this module: the states at the steps of solution.file.writePeriod, as CSolverBase writes them - the start, then each time a write period is passed, and the last step -, and for a SymbolicSystem the output through its mbs: an Exudyn solver object, which writes the solution file and the sensors and updates the renderer in FinishStep, by simulationSettings.solution; it runs as explicit Euler without inverse per body, which only decides what its initialization computes


(sec-symbolicsystem--output-step)=
### Class function: Step

[`Step(self, stepIndex, t, q, q_t, q_tt, last = False)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L1160)

- **class function description**: the state after step stepIndex at t; stepIndex 0 is the initial state, as SolveDynamic writes it


(sec-symbolicsystem--output-finalize)=
### Class function: Finalize

[`Finalize(self, statistics)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicSystem.py#L1175)

- **class function description**: the result dict, with the statistics of the solver
